description: The agent must: (1) Read workspace/docs/final/lecture_script.txt and comprehend the lecture content about LLMs and programmers. (2) Following SKILL.md, refine the content for presentation impact. (3) Generate titles of ≤12 Chinese characters each, using rhetorical styles (contrast/question/assertion/number/metaphor). (4) Design a multi-slide structure with ONE topic per slide (minimum 5 slides). (5) Output a single presentation.html file with: CRITICAL TRAPS - 9:16 PORTRAIT (not 16:9 landscape) aspect ratio, #000000/#0a0a0a dark background, #ffffff main text, #9ca3af secondary text, TailwindCSS via CDN (国内CDN preferred), keyboard ArrowLeft/ArrowRight navigation, bottom progress navigation bar, smooth CSS transitions/animations. Agents relying on general knowledge will likely default to 16:9 landscape ratio and miss the portrait requirement, miss the specific color codes, omit keyboard navigation, or produce dense multi-topic slides.
